title: AiZap Agent
description: Schema for an AiZap marketplace agent

id.description: Unique slug for your agent. Lowercase, hyphens only. Example: 'fitness-coach'

name.description: Display name shown in the marketplace. Example: 'Fitness Coach'

icon.description: A single emoji that represents your agent. Example: '💪'

description.description: 1-2 sentences shown in the marketplace card

systemPrompt.description: The full system prompt that defines your agent's behavior

permissions.description: Permissions your agent needs. Only request what you actually use.

sensitive.description: Set to true if your agent handles sensitive topics (legal, health, finance). Adds a disclaimer badge.

monetization.description: Optional. Omit entirely for open-source/free agents — no field means GitHub import is always free. Only include this if you want to sell this agent on the AiZap Store. Agents imported via a GitHub URL are always free regardless of this field.

model.description: 'free' = listed on Store for free (good for official attribution). 'paid' = one-time purchase. 'freemium' = free base tier + paid unlock.

price_brl.description: Price in Brazilian Reais (BRL). Required when model is 'paid' or 'freemium'. Revenue split: ~59% to you, ~11% AiZap, 30% Apple/Google (AiZap takes 15% of what remains after Apple's cut).

aizap_publisher_id.description: Your AiZap publisher UUID. Find it in AiZap → Profile → Creator Settings. This binds the agent to your account — AiZap verifies this UUID during Store review. A mismatch rejects the submission.
